edits.note: A.8 CHG-R1-01: R106s placement rule, target, fallback and booking (new r8 paragraph before the per-region placement)
edits.new:
**r8 R106s placement (CHG-R1-01).** R106s (B.4, B.8) sits between U101 FLT (pin 14, net `N_FLT`) and the F17 pad (net
`CHG_EFUSE_FLT`). The H.23(n) bound holds at any position of R106s, provided that the F17 pad is the only exposed copper of
`CHG_EFUSE_FLT` apart from the R106s terminal. The layout therefore meets these rules:

- the `CHG_EFUSE_FLT` copper from the F17 pad to R106s is solder-masked over its full length and carries no test pad;
- the `N_FLT` copper from pin 14 to R106s is solder-masked over its full length and carries no test pad;
- every via on either net is tented on both sides;
- the R106s courtyard meets the courtyard rules of the region that holds it, and the T-A-06 DRC is the gate.

The placement target is the tab X bottom beside the F17 pad, joined to the pad by one tented via. The tab X bottom admits
1 % logic series resistors (the Tab X bottom row below; the A.7 thermal band rule). On the bottom, the polyimide sheet
covers the R106s terminals, and a hand-solder bridge on the top tap field cannot reach them; a top-side position in the tap
field would add new pairs to the short table above. The position must meet the bottom clearance rule (A.7, H.23(c)) and
stay out of the FT1 keep-out and its RTV lane; TODO(calc: H.23(d) bottom-clearance check of the R106s 0402 courtyard,
1.9 x 1.0 mm). If no tab X bottom position meets the rule, R106s goes on the footprint interior top as near to pin 14 as
the courtyard check allows, under the same masking rules. Booking: one 0402 courtyard (1.90 mm², the courtyard list below)
is added to the H.23(e) adopted bottom total of 392.9 mm² of 569.1 mm² (69.04 %); TODO(calc: H.23(e) and H.23(e2) with
R106s on the tab X bottom).

edits.new:

| T-C-05c | **Powered FLT pad-bridge injection (r8, finding CHG-R1-01)** | A.8 rows F05-F17, F06-F17 and F17-F15; B.4 R106s: the R106s bound on the FLT current against the 10 mA absolute maximum (SLVSE94G §6.1), the EN level under a bridge, and the FLT readback level | CR + bench Teensy on emulated supplies (T-C class). PSU1 on VCHG-IN, DMM, SCOPE. Pins 30 and 31 drive emulated EN nets, each with the 10 kOhm EN-to-GND bodge resistor. The bridge is a jumper from the bridged pad to the F17 pad through a 1.00 ohm 1 % shunt; the DMM reads the shunt voltage. Steps: (1) Set VCHG-IN to 16.0 V (FLT released). Measure pin 35. (2) Set VCHG-IN to 8.0 V (below the UVLO 9.70-10.13 V of B.4, so FLT is asserted). Measure pin 35. (3) Connect the bridge F05-F17. (4) Set pin 30 HIGH. Measure the shunt current, the pin-30 EN net and pin 35. (5) Set pin 30 LOW. Measure pin 35. (6) Set VCHG-IN to 16.0 V. Repeat steps 4 and 5. (7) Remove the bridge. Connect the bridge F06-F17 and repeat steps 2 to 6 with pin 31. (8) Remove the bridge. When the T-C-06 bench state gives H2c = 1, connect the bridge F17-F15 at VCHG-IN 8.0 V and measure the shunt current. (9) Remove the bridge. Repeat steps 1 and 2. Record the FR-08 and FR-23 flags of the firmware in each step (recorded, not scored here) | Step 1: pin 35 >= 3.10 V (H.23(n) 3.130 V minimum). Step 2: pin 35 <= 0.33 V (H.23(n) 0.325 V maximum; VIL 0.940 V). Step 4 at 8.0 V: shunt current 2.6-3.4 mA (H.23(n) 2.657-3.377 mA, below the 10 mA absolute maximum), EN net >= 3.0 V (H.23(n) 3.017 V), pin 35 HIGH. Steps 4 and 5 at 16.0 V: pin 35 follows the bridged output; with pin 30 HIGH the shunt current is < 0.01 mA (FLT released, leakage <= 150 nA, SLVSE94G §6.5); with pin 30 LOW the shunt carries only the pin-35 pad pull-up current, <= 0.35 mA (3.465 V into the 11 kOhm minimum pull-up of the H.23(n) inputs). Step 5: pin 35 LOW. Step 8: shunt current <= 1.72 mA (H.23(n) 1.719 mA). Step 9: the step 1 and step 2 results again, within 0.05 V, so the FLT output is undamaged | Shunt current above 3.4 mA or EN net below 3.0 V: inspect the `CHG_EFUSE_FLT` route for exposed copper between F17 and R106s and check the fitted R106s value (A.8 masking rules). If the route and value are correct, measure the Teensy 3V3 and the driver level, re-run `round4/calc/r7_calc.py` H.23(n) with the measured values, and raise R106s only while the step 2 level keeps >= 0.3 V margin to VIL. Step 2 level above 0.33 V: measure the pin-35 pad pull-up (T-C-05), re-run H.23(n), and lower R106s only while the step 4 bound stays >= 2x below 10 mA. Step 9 changed: replace U101 and repeat T-C-04 |
